description: Hand-maintained ledger of whether each Trellage profile has been observed to work end-to-end when driven as a Herdr agent (launched, detected, and able to complete a one-line task). This is a curated signal refreshed by manual verification runs, not a live probe: Trellage cannot detect Herdr-side bugs (agent detection, consent-dialog handling, etc.) automatically. Status values: 'verified' (completed an end-to-end round trip), 'known-issue' (observed to fail, see issue/notes), 'untested' (no verification run recorded). See docs/rlm-herdr-handoff.md for the source report and category definitions (A-G).
